orgDesign.companyProfile: Proposed internal technology operating capability for a specialist investment manager and its portfolio companies.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Five logical responsibility areas, led as one product by the Technology Principal. People can hold multiple roles; headcount and actual reporting lines are unknown. Company leaders, IC, boards, finance reviewers, and external experts retain their respective authorities.
